question: What was the value per kg of Luxembourg's imports from EU27 and from non-EU27 partners in 2025?

limitations.message: Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity.

sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (
      partner_is_eu27_2020 OR (
        partner_is_special AND trade_type = 'intra'
      )
    )
    THEN 'EU27'
    ELSE 'NON_EU27'
  END AS key,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg,
  SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT qty_kg IS NULL) AS value_eur_with_qty
FROM v_lu_trade
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'import'
GROUP BY
  key,
  flow
ORDER BY
  value_eur DESC
LIMIT 10000
title: imports 2025: EU27 countries 1.23 €/kg · Non-EU27 countries 19.71 €/kg
insight: The value per kilogram of Luxembourg's imports in 2025 was 1.23 euros from EU27 countries and 19.71 euros from non-EU27 partners.
This shows that imports from non-EU27 countries had a much higher value per kilogram compared to those from EU27 countries.
The difference in unit values highlights the varying nature of goods imported from these two groups of partners.
Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity.
